criteria.status: principal materials and features supported; some openings/interior schematic
evidence: The photo and source notes support red-brown brick, slate-like gray roofs, upper dark timber/shingle cladding, rectangular windows, chimney stacks, and garage doors. These features appear in the revised model and are represented with distinct assigned materials.

The single oblique photo is partly tree-obscured and does not identify camera azimuth. Door/window placement on obscured elevations, the exact main entrance position, roof junction details, and the interior plan cannot be verified from this source set; the modeled interior is explicitly schematic.
criteria.reason: The principal facade palette and distinctive roof details are now represented. Some openings and the interior remain interpretations because the available photo does not show all elevations or room layout.
